name: Natsukawa Kaito
source: He is a childhood friend of Haruta and Rio, and is like an older brother to them. He works as a photographer and has returned to town for work. He looks like a playboy who is used to having fun, but he is actually good with women. In contrast to Haruta, he gives off strong male pheromones, and his overwhelming sex techniques easily make Rio and Nanoha his slaves.
